bullets: How one $100 injection is re-spent in shrinking rounds: $100, then $80, then $64, until national income settles at $500, five times the injection
slides.heading: The multiplier process: one injection, shrinking rounds
slides.notes: Welcome everyone in and say: today we follow one injection round the circular flow - and watch each round shrink.

bullets: Describe the multiplier process: an injection is re-spent in geometrically shrinking rounds as leakages bite
Explain why national income settles at $500, five times the $100 injection, so the multiplier is 5
slides.heading: What we will learn
slides.notes: Read the two goals aloud and tell the class: by the end you will be able to explain why the rounds shrink and where the total settles.

bullets: The government spends $100 and that $100 is spent again by whoever receives it
So is the total $200, $500, or does it just keep growing?
slides.heading: $100 in - how much income in total?
slides.notes: Ask the class: $100 goes in - how much national income in total? Take two or three answers, then say: hold them, because the rounds themselves decide.

bullets: Each round, households re-spend only part of their income; the rest leaks out as saving, tax and imports
Here $20 of the first $100 leaks out, so four-fifths is re-spent and each round is four-fifths of the last
The shrinking rounds add up to a finite total: $500, five times the injection, so the multiplier is 5
slides.heading: Leakages shrink every round
slides.notes: Stress the deciding habit: never carry the full amount into the next round - subtract the leakage first, then re-spend what is left.

bullets: Government spending injects $100 into firms
The money flows round the circular flow to households as income, ready to be spent again
slides.heading: The circular flow: an injection enters
slides.notes: Play scene 1 and point to the injection arrow: follow the $100 token from firms round to households.

bullets: Round 1 adds the full $100 of income
But $20 leaks out as saving, tax and imports, so only $80 goes round again
slides.heading: Round 1: $100 in, $20 leaks out
slides.notes: Play scene 2 and watch the token shrink: name the $20 leakage before the next round starts.

bullets: Round 2 adds $80 and round 3 adds $64, each four-fifths of the round before
The bars shrink geometrically while the running total climbs to $244
slides.heading: Rounds 2 and 3 shrink: $80, then $64
slides.notes: Play scene 3 slowly: check each bar against the last - $100, $80, $64 - and watch the total bar climb.

bullets: Aggregate demand shifts right in shrinking steps, by less each round
National income settles at $500, five times the $100 injection
slides.heading: Aggregate demand settles at $500
slides.notes: Play scene 4 and follow AD: each shift is smaller than the last until the final equilibrium at $500.

bullets: Round 1 adds $100, round 2 adds $80, round 3 adds $64 - each round is four-fifths of the last
The rounds keep shrinking towards zero, and their sum settles at $500, so the multiplier is $500 / $100 = 5
slides.heading: Worked example: summing the shrinking rounds
slides.notes: Work it slowly: Step 1, list the rounds $100, $80, $64. Step 2, note each is four-fifths of the last because $20 in every $100 leaks out. Step 3, the geometric sum settles at $500, five times the injection.

bullets: In pairs: work out how much round 4 adds, and what the running total becomes after round 4
Then swap and check: did you shrink the round by four-fifths before adding it?
slides.heading: Your turn: predict round 4
slides.notes: Give pairs three minutes. Listen for shrinking-round working, then take two pairs answers: round 4 adds $51.20 and the total reaches $295.20.

bullets: Your exit ticket asks you to correct a student who thinks every round adds the full $100 again
Name the leakages and the shrinking rounds to earn full credit
slides.heading: Exit ticket: prove it before you leave
slides.notes: Point to the exit ticket and remind the class: the strongest answers shrink each round by the leakage instead of re-spending the full injection.
